entity.summary: Centralized cryptocurrency exchange in an orderly wind-down after announcing phased service restrictions, an August 2026 trading stop, and planned termination of trading-platform operations on January 31, 2027.
entity.notes: BitMart announced an orderly wind-down on July 26, 2026. New registrations, deposits, new positions, new spot orders, and automated trading services began stopping in phases from 01:30 UTC. Spot, futures, and other trading services are scheduled to stop on August 26, 2026, while formal trading-platform operations are planned to end on January 31, 2027. Withdrawals remain available during the wind-down. HEI therefore uses limited and leaves death_reason and death_date null until the relevant shutdown stages are verified. BitMart's official history gives an exact launch date of March 15, 2018. The origin field follows the current official user agreement, which identifies GBM Global Inc. with a Marshall Islands registration number and address.

events.title: BitMart officially launched
events.description: BitMart officially launched its cryptocurrency trading platform on March 15, 2018.
events.notes: The exact launch date is stated in BitMart's official operating history.

events.title: BitMart reported a large-scale hot-wallet security breach
events.description: BitMart identified a large-scale security breach involving an Ethereum hot wallet and a BNB Smart Chain hot wallet and temporarily restricted withdrawals during its response.
events.notes: BitMart remained active and later resumed affected deposit and withdrawal services.

events.title: BitMart announced an orderly wind-down
events.description: BitMart announced phased restrictions beginning July 26, 2026, a stop to spot, futures, and other trading services on August 26, 2026, and planned termination of trading-platform operations on January 31, 2027.
events.notes: The exchange is not classified dead at announcement time because withdrawals remain available and the principal trading and platform-termination dates are in the future. Later shutdown_effective events require direct verification.

evidence.title: Important Notice Regarding the Orderly Cessation of BitMart Operations
evidence.notes: First-party notice defines the phased wind-down, including immediate registration, deposit, and new-order restrictions, the August 26 trading stop, the January 31, 2027 platform-termination date, and continuing withdrawal access during the transition.
